description: Resource schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentGoal. An Agent Goal expresses a Well-Architected objective (a title, optional description, and the pillars it targets) within an Agent Profile, used to focus Well-Architected Agent recommendations.

Pillar.description: A Well-Architected pillar the Agent Goal targets.
Pillar.markdownDescription:
A Well-Architected pillar the Agent Goal targets.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: COST_OPTIMIZATION | SECURITY | RESILIENCE | PERFORMANCE | OPERATIONAL_EXCELLENCE  
Update requires: No interruption

Arn.description: The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Goal, composed of the parent profile ARN and the goal id.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Goal, composed of the parent profile ARN and the goal id.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:aws([a-z0-9-]+)?:wellarchitected:[a-z0-9-]{6,64}:[0-9]{12}:agent-profile/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/agent-goal/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

ProfileArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile that owns this goal. Pass `!Ref` of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here.
